prompt: A phone plan costs $30 a month and includes 10 GB of data. Each extra GB costs $4. There is also a $10 monthly device fee. You use 17 GB in a month. What is your total bill for that month?
explanation: Extra data: 17 - 10 = 7 GB, at 7 x $4 = $28. Total: $30 (plan) + $28 (extra data) + $10 (device fee) = $68. The $58 option forgets the device fee, and $98 wrongly charges for all 17 GB on top of the plan (17 x $4 = $68, plus $30).
